title: M1: No Story reaches the public site around its checklist (MoM)
description:
Use case (next arc, 2026-11-22, Ryan): an imported, pod-loaded or translated Story on Machines on Machines cannot be published until its own checklist is closed, and the refusal names the open step.

**Tasks:** verify the per-language checklist gate (#1731) live on MoM; PPY-473f8f PR 2 (review stamp and delegation); PPY-cc6a0f. The translation agent stays in PPY-98f88e.

**Exit test (on MoM):** Ryan tries to publish an imported Story and a translation with an open step; both are refused naming the step; a Story with a closed checklist publishes. Then close PPY-473f8f.
